This draft MGN provides information on the methodology that can be used to assess the marine navigational safety and emergency response risks that may be posed to waterway users from Aquaculture sites.  It does not introduce new requirements to those already in place but is intended to direct the reader to the current relevant guidance and information as published by the relevant marine regulator.

Contact email and/or postal address – this should be in the consultation document: (This is also contained in the consultation document).

Marine Safety and PNT Services 

Maritime and Coastguard Agency 
Bay 2/24 
Spring Place 
105 Commercial Road 
Southampton 
SO15 1EG 

Telephone: 020 3817 2000 

Email: navigationsafety@mcga.gov.uk
